title: Nice experience at the Sagrada Familia
text:
Dolors was very lovely, she explained everything to us very clearly and entertainingly! It was a nice experience and the Sagrada Familia was wonderful!
Thanks a million
author: mar_ajos_m354

title: Hidden culinary gems
text: A great way to experience the culinary secrets of Barcelona. Ariana was one to f the best guides we’ve ever had. Great stories. Completely entertaining.
author: Kimberly_B

title: Ariadna is the best!
text: Learn and eat & drink!   Ariadna made us feel like old friends.  So many tidbits of knowledge, and of course, prompt service everywhere!
author: Edmund_K

title: Excellent option to enjoy the city
text: I really like the places that Ariadna chose. The wine and food were very good. The conversation was very interesting since we were a small group. I loved that too. She also gave us  information about the city. I really recommend this tour. I could have some facts about the city and enjoy the food and drinks at the same time.
author: LetyG668

title: Incredibly nice tour
text: It was really nice. Having a combination of city and food tour. Ariadne did an awesome job at this. She was very well informed about everything and funny as well.
author: 783kv

title: Ariana is an excellent foodie
text: The food tour was excellent!  Ariana is a fabulous tour guide full of knowledge and energy.  Not only did we eat great food but we learned an extensive amount of history as well.  I recommend this tour to anyone who wants to eat like a local for one day!
author: X4435ULmichaelw

title: When in Barcelona eat like a resident
text: Ariana was extremely knowledgeable and friendly.  The places she took us to we delicious and we learned a lot along the way
author: Michael_W

title: Had a fantastic...
text: Had a fantastic experience! Our tour guide was friendly and knowledgeable, and very funny! We had the best time and learned a lot from a local that I don't think we would have gotten from other experiences
author: Stephanie_W

title: Entertaining afternoon
text: Very funny! I didn't really expect to have such a good time, each stop was super different and I loved that. Thanks to our guide Joaquin.
author: Delfilenziii

title: The best TAPAS TOUR you can do in Barcelona!
text:
I went on this tapas tour and it was a great experience! 

Fantastic tour with which you can enjoy a great selection of top quality tapas. In addition, you can learn about the history of Barcelona... A great tour to know Barcelona from a different perspective.
